boundary_evidence.start: NullStr and NullRF share $413354. The stored map ends at $413374; RMGRVersion occupies two bytes before InitResources at $413376. PC references in the Resource Manager identify the map and null string.
boundary_evidence.end: RsrcMapEntry ends with a short branch to SizeRExit at $4148A6. The Dialog Manager ICRect starts at $4148A8.

restored_equates.reason: The ROM StdEntry LINK allocates 50 bytes for the original file I/O parameter block. Later code adds hierarchical file and resource override fields.

restored_equates.reason: The original frame ends at ioBlock; the ROM LINK displacement is -50.

edits.description: Restored the complete Resource Manager from NullStr and NullRF through RsrcMapEntry. Retained the released header, history through November 1985, register assignments, applicable routine contracts, format comments, equates, and matching body comments.

Matched operations within corresponding released routines using resolved equates and operand values. The ROM determines instruction widths, branch destinations, direct calls, and encodings. A recorded source operation may use a different encoding or branch destination in the later source. Omitted comments that describe later override maps, resource decompression, hierarchical file calls, and disk font cache paths.

Retained the original NullStr and NullRF aliases, empty resource map, MTyps, MNams, and RMGRVersion definitions. NullRMSize remains 30, while the stored empty map occupies 32 bytes including its null name word. The version word adds two bytes. These 34 bytes are the only data directives in the module.

Restored ROZInit and ReDoMap for the original ROM resource layout. The count and map size follow the offset at ROMRsrcStart. ROZInit allocates a zone of 4 times (26 plus the resource count), plus the map size. ReDoMap copies the stored map and fills its resource handles. Later source uses a combined resource layout.

Restored the locked-resource path in SuperLoad. The ROM allocates a pointer, creates an empty handle, installs its master pointer, and changes the block header. It then copies the resource from the preload buffer and sets lock and purge flags.

Preserved GetMaxLoad reads from absolute PreExtra, PreUnlock, and PreLock addresses, at $10, $0C, and $08. The released history records the correction to cache-relative reads on 13 January 1986. The reconstructed source keeps the ROM behavior.

Restored the ORFCommon printer compatibility test through RecoverHandle and GetResInfo. It recognizes STR $E000 and selects BootDrive. Restored OpenRFPerm and StdEntry permission handling through RMGRPerm and the original 50-byte file I/O frame.
Restored zero as the unfiltered FirstRes and NextRes selector. The later source uses negative values. UniqueID retains the full nonnegative ID range rather than the later minimum of 128.

Restored UpdateBufferSize and MinBufferSize from the ROM. They choose a heap buffer using the file size and largest free block, with a minimum of 4 KB. Restored the earlier CmpFrmDsk copy sequence and read-position updates. The released history describes fixes in January and May 1986 and a stack buffer fallback.

Restored CountResources map traversal and GetIndResource type/index reuse through the HandleScan cache. The later source replaced both with separate resource-cache lookup. Kept NextMap limited to one map when ResOneDeep is set.

Restored the original standard entry and exit frames and ROM map insertion. SwapRomMap inserts the ROM map before the system map, restores map links on removal, adjusts CurMap when needed, and exchanges ResLoad with TmpResLoad.

Used the released PlainOldCheckLoad body for the classic CheckLoad path. Restored direct master pointer state changes in DoRomEntry, SetPL, DetachResource, ChangedResource, AddResource, and RmveResource. Restored SetResPurge installation and removal of the current zone purge hook.

Replaced later includes with required released equates and two restored frame equates. Used OPWORD for named A-line traps and explicit PC addressing for static-data and code references. Every instruction is assembled from a mnemonic and operands.

reconstruction_notes.4273156: The ROM creates one resource zone from the original count and map size stored at ROMRsrcStart. The later source uses a different combined resource format.
reconstruction_notes.4273242: The ROM resizes and copies the stored map, assigns reference number 1, and fills its ROM resource handles. The later source constructs a map from combined resource entries.
reconstruction_notes.4273364: For locked resources, the ROM allocates a pointer, creates an empty handle, and changes the block headers directly. Later code replaces this allocation path.
reconstruction_notes.4273546: The ROM reads PreExtra, PreUnLock, and PreLock as absolute addresses. The released history records their correction to cache offsets on 13 January 1986.
reconstruction_notes.4273996: The ROM checks the old printer filename pointer through RecoverHandle and GetResInfo. For STR $E000 it sets the volume to BootDrive. Later source replaced this pointer test.
reconstruction_notes.4274298: The ROM uses D1 equal to zero for an unfiltered file-order search. The later source uses negative D1 instead.
reconstruction_notes.4275322: The ROM counts matching resources by scanning the map chain. The later source builds a separate resource cache.
reconstruction_notes.4275364: The ROM reuses the last type and index through the HandleScan cache, then scans maps when that cache does not apply. The later source replaced this traversal.
reconstruction_notes.4277476: The ROM installs RPHook in the current zone or clears the purge procedure pointer. It predates the later disk font cache hook.
reconstruction_notes.4273928: The ROM clears handles for resources without the system heap attribute. The later source tests heap bounds instead.
reconstruction_notes.4274426: These ROM helpers choose a heap buffer from the file size and largest free block, with a minimum of 4 KB. The later source adds a stack buffer fallback.
reconstruction_notes.4274886: The ROM retains the disk compaction code that the released history identifies as changed in January and May 1986.
reconstruction_notes.4275632: The ROM searches the full nonnegative resource ID range. The later source reserves IDs below 128.
reconstruction_notes.4276054: The ROM uses a 50-byte file I/O frame and the original map insertion protocol. Later override and hierarchical file fields are absent.
reconstruction_notes.4276102: The ROM inserts or removes ROMMapHndl before the system map, rewrites the current map reference when needed, and exchanges ResLoad with TmpResLoad.
reconstruction_notes.4276482: The ROM creates master pointers into ROM and sets their state bits directly.
reconstruction_notes.4276534: The released PlainOldCheckLoad body retains this classic loading path. The ROM predates resource decompression and later override handling.
reconstruction_notes.4276664: The ROM derives lock and purge state from resource attributes and writes the master pointer flag byte directly.

verification.method: Called Reconstruction/Tools/verify.py verify_module in an independent temporary directory. The verifier assembled for MC68000, linked at the ROM address, checked entry points and relocations, and compared every emitted byte.
verification.scope: The entire emitted span matches the ROM. MPW assembly has not been run. Byte equality does not establish original source formatting or original names for reconstructed labels.
